# Loading GWAS Study Data

```{r load_gwas_date_data}

gwas_date <- data.table::fread(here::here("data/gwas_catalog/gwas-catalog-v1.0.3.1-ancestries-r2026-09-13.tsv"),
                               select = c("STUDY ACCESSION", "DATE", "PUBMED ID"),
                               sep = "\t", 
                               quote = "")

gwas_date = gwas_date |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~ gsub(" ", "_", .x))

gwas_date <- gwas_date |>
  distinct()

```

```{r load_gwas_study_data}

gwas_study_info <- data.table::fread(here::here("output/icd_map/gwas_study_accession_gbd_causes.csv"))

gwas_study_info = gwas_study_info |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~ gsub(" ", "_", .x))

gwas_study_info = gwas_study_info |>
  dplyr::filter(cause != "") |>
  dplyr::filter(include == T)

gwas_study_info  <-
  gwas_study_info  |>
  # group into broader categories 
  mutate(cause_grp = case_when(
    grepl("diabetes", cause, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Diabetes",
    grepl("chronic kidney disease", cause, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Chronic kidney disease",
    grepl("hemorr", cause, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Hemorrhagic stroke",
    grepl("lip|pharynx", cause, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mouth and throat cancer",
    grepl("lung cancer", cause, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Lung Cancer",
    grepl("cirrhosis", cause, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Chronic Liver Disease",
    TRUE ~ cause
  )) 
  # mutate(cause = 
  #          stringr::str_to_title(
  #          stringr::str_replace_all(cause, 
  #                                         pattern = "and", 
  #                                         replacement = "&")
  #          )
  #          ) 


gwas_study_info <-
gwas_study_info |>
  distinct(PUBMED_ID, STUDY_ACCESSION, cause, cause_grp)

gwas_study_info  |>
  distinct(cause_grp, PUBMED_ID) |>
  group_by(cause_grp) |>
  summarise(n_papers = n()) |>
  arrange(n_papers)


```

## Load ancestry + sample size information

```{r load_gwas_ancestry_date}

gwas_ancest_info <-  data.table::fread(here::here("output/gwas_cat/gwas_ancest_discovery_subset_processed.csv"))

gwas_ancest_info  = 
  gwas_ancest_info  |>
  rename_all(~gsub(" ", "_", .x))

# filter only to included STUDY ACCESSIONS
gwas_study_info$STUDY_ACCESSION |> unique() |> length()

gwas_ancest_info <-
  gwas_ancest_info |>
  dplyr::filter(STUDY_ACCESSION %in% unique(gwas_study_info$STUDY_ACCESSION))

gwas_ancest_info |>
    dplyr::filter(is.na(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS)) 

gwas_ancest_info  =
gwas_ancest_info |>
dplyr::filter(!is.na(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS))


```

```{r group_ancestry}

source(here::here("code/pop_desc_processing/plot_gwas_ancest_comp.R"))

grouped_ancest = vector()
broad_ancest_cat = unique(gwas_ancest_info$BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY)

for(study_ancest in broad_ancest_cat){
  
grouped_ancest[study_ancest] = group_ancestry_fn(study_ancest)

}

grouped_ancest_map = data.frame(ancestry_group = grouped_ancest,
                                BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY = broad_ancest_cat
                                )


print("See some example mappings between BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY and ancestry_group")
print(dplyr::slice_sample(grouped_ancest_map, n = 5))

gwas_ancest_info = dplyr::left_join(
            gwas_ancest_info,
            grouped_ancest_map,
            by = "BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY")

gwas_ancest_info = gwas_ancest_info |>
                    dplyr::mutate(ancestry_group = factor(ancestry_group, 
                                                          levels = ancestry_levels))


gwas_ancest_info <-
  left_join(gwas_ancest_info,
            gwas_date,
            by = c("STUDY_ACCESSION", "PUBMED_ID"))


gwas_info <- full_join(

)
```

## Load / clean up annotated cohort names 

```{r clean_cohort_annotations}

cohort_norm <- data.table::fread(here::here("training_papers_test_cohort_norm.csv"))

cohort_norm <-
cohort_norm  |>
  filter(not_cohort == FALSE) 

cohort_names <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data/cohort/cohort_desc_v3_sep17.xlsx"),
                                    sheet = 1) |>
                select(short_name, cohort_norm = full_name, cohort_group) |>
                distinct()

cohort_norm <-
cohort_norm  |>
  mutate(cohort_norm = ifelse(cohort_norm == "",
                              "Other",
                              cohort_norm))

cohort_names <- cohort_names |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        cohort_norm = gsub("\u00A0", " ", cohort_norm)
    )

cohort_norm <- 
left_join(
  cohort_norm,
  cohort_names,
  relationship = "many-to-many",
  by = "cohort_norm") 

# drop cohorts without cohort groups and are likely not cohorts
cohort_norm  <- 
  cohort_norm  |>
  filter(not_cohort == F | !is.na(cohort_group))

cohort_norm  <-
  cohort_norm  |>
  tidyr::separate_longer_delim(cohort_group, ", ")

# exclude probable reference or functional genetics cohorts:
cohort_norm  <-
cohort_norm  |>
  filter(!cohort_group %in% 
           c("gnomAD",
             "GTEx",
             "1000 Genomes",
             "HapMap",
             "ENCODE",
             "Roadmap Epigenomics",
             "eQTLGen",
             "HRC"))

cohort_norm <-
  cohort_norm |>
  mutate(cohort_group = 
           case_when(is.na(cohort_group) & 
                       cohort_norm == "Genetics Of Sepsis and Septic Shock" ~ 
                       "Genetics Of Sepsis and Septic Shock (GenOSept)",
                     is.na(cohort_group) & cohort_norm == "deCODE genetics" ~ 
                       "deCODE genetics",
                     cohort_group == "CHARGE" ~ 
                       "Cohorts for Heart and Aging Research in Genomic Epidemiology (CHARGE)",
            TRUE ~ cohort_group)
         )

```




# Ancestry composition by disease

## Rheumatic heart disease

```{r rhd_numbers}

gwas_info |>
  filter(cause_grp == "Rheumatic heart disease")  |>
  distinct(PUBMED_ID, STUDY_ACCESSION) |>
  group_by(PUBMED_ID) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  filter(n > 1)

```

### Without any correction 

```{r rhd_no_correction}

window_months <- 6
  
rhd_no_correction <- gwas_info |>
  filter(cause_grp == "Rheumatic heart disease") |>
  arrange(DATE) |>
  group_by(ancestry_group) |>
  mutate(ancest_cumsum = cumsum(as.numeric(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS))) |>
  add_final_totals(window_months = window_months) |>
  ungroup()

rhd_no_correction_smooth <- rhd_no_correction |>
  mutate(month = floor_date(DATE, "month")) |>
  group_by(ancestry_group, month) |>
  summarise(ancest_cumsum = max(ancest_cumsum), 
            .groups = "drop") |>
  complete(ancestry_group,
           month = seq(min(month), 
                       max(month), 
                       by = "month")) |>   # same grid for all groups
  group_by(ancestry_group) |>
  arrange(month, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  fill(ancest_cumsum, .direction = "down") |>                       # carry totals forward
  replace_na(list(ancest_cumsum = 0)) |>                            # 0 before first study
  mutate(smooth = slide_dbl(ancest_cumsum, mean,
                            .before = window_months, 
                            .after = 0)) |>  # trailing window
  ungroup()

ggplot(rhd_no_correction_smooth, aes(x = month, 
                       y = smooth / 1e6, 
                       fill = ancestry_group)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y", 
               date_breaks = "2 years") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Individuals in GWAS catalog (millions)",
       title = "Rheumatic heart disease papers (standard figure)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ancestry_colors, name = "Ancestry group")


```


### Correcting for overlap within the same paper

```{r rhd_within_paper_overlap}

# some PAPERS have multiple study accession per PUBMED_ID for rhd
multiple_study_accessions <-
  gwas_info |>
  filter(cause_grp == "Rheumatic heart disease")  |>
  distinct(PUBMED_ID, STUDY_ACCESSION) |>
  group_by(PUBMED_ID) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  filter(n > 1) |>
  pull(PUBMED_ID)

# which of these have difference sample sizes per STUDY_ACCESSION + ANCESTRY_GROUP
# if they have have the sample size per  STUDY_ACCESSION + ANCESTRY_GROUP we'll assume
# these are the same participants duplicated
difference_sample_size_per_study <-
gwas_info |>
    filter(cause_grp == "Rheumatic heart disease") |> 
    filter(PUBMED_ID %in% multiple_study_accessions) |>  
    distinct(PUBMED_ID, 
             STUDY_ACCESSION, 
             ancestry_group, 
             NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS)  |> 
  group_by(PUBMED_ID, 
           ancestry_group) |> 
  summarise(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS_MAX = max(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS), 
            NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS_MIN = min(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS_MAX != NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS_MIN) |>
  mutate(dif  = NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS_MAX - NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS_MIN)

difference_sample_size_per_study 

difference_sample_size_per_study  |>
  mutate(dif_prop = 100 * dif / NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS_MIN) |> 
  filter()

# manual review of STUDY SAMPLE SIZES  34594039, 40465716, 39024449, 34662886, 34662886, 30104761
# same samples used for discovery across all STUDY_ACCESSION
# difference is just availability of phenotype info
# taking max sample size per ancestry group is appropriate

rhd_control_in_paper <- gwas_info |>
  filter(cause_grp == "Rheumatic heart disease") |>
  group_by(PUBMED_ID, BROAD_ANCESTRAL_CATEGORY) |>
  slice_max(order_by = NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS,
            n = 1, 
            with_ties = FALSE) |>  # avoid double-counting ties
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(DATE) |>
  group_by(ancestry_group) |>
  mutate(ancest_cumsum = cumsum(as.numeric(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS))) 

# double check not multiple STUDY ACCESSION per ancestry group:
rhd_control_in_paper |> 
  group_by(ancestry_group, PUBMED_ID) |> 
  summarise(n = n(),
            .groups = 'drop') |> 
  filter(n > 1)

rhd_control_in_paper_plot_df <-
  rhd_control_in_paper |>
  add_final_totals() |>
  ungroup()

rhd_smooth_in_paper <- rhd_control_in_paper_plot_df |>
  mutate(month = floor_date(DATE, "month")) |>
  group_by(ancestry_group, month) |>
  summarise(ancest_cumsum = max(ancest_cumsum), .groups = "drop") |>
  complete(ancestry_group,
           month = seq(min(month), max(month), by = "month")) |>   # same grid for all groups
  group_by(ancestry_group) |>
  arrange(month, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  fill(ancest_cumsum, .direction = "down") |>                       # carry totals forward
  replace_na(list(ancest_cumsum = 0)) |>                            # 0 before first study
  mutate(smooth = slide_dbl(ancest_cumsum, mean,
                            .before = window_months, .after = 0)) |>  # trailing window
  ungroup()

ggplot(rhd_smooth_in_paper, 
       aes(x = month, 
           y = smooth / 1e6, 
           fill = ancestry_group)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y", 
               date_breaks = "2 years") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Individuals in GWAS catalog (millions)",
       title = "Rheumatic heart disease papers (accounting for within paper overlap)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ancestry_colors, 
                    name = "Ancestry group")

```

### Correctiion for all overlap

Cohort reuse etc. 


### Get full set of cohorts for RHD

```{r}

rhd_pmids <-
gwas_info |>
    filter(cause_grp == "Rheumatic heart disease") |> 
     pull(PUBMED_ID) |> 
     unique()

rhd_cohort_norm <- cohort_norm |>
                   filter(pubmed_id %in% rhd_pmids)

# manual check of cohorts by reading papers
# remove non-discovery cohorts

# WTCCC is not a GWAS discovery cohort for 28492228, it is a method of recruitment etc. followed
# by this paper
# 'Following the approach of the Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium' 
# thus drop

# Also HGDP is just used as a reference panel in this paper, thus drop:
rhd_cohort_norm <-
  rhd_cohort_norm |>
  filter(!(pubmed_id == "28492228" & cohort_group == "WTCCC")) |>
  filter(!(pubmed_id == "28492228" & cohort_group == "HGDP")) 
  
# Similarly for 32488134, 
# WTCCC is not a GWAS discovery cohort, it is a method of recruitment etc. 
rhd_cohort_norm <-
  rhd_cohort_norm |>
   filter(!(pubmed_id == "32488134" & cohort_group == "WTCCC"))

# For pubmed 34662886
# Only discovery cohort is UK Biobank, other cohorts are for imputation or replication
rhd_cohort_norm <-
  rhd_cohort_norm |>
  filter(!(pubmed_id == "34662886" & cohort_group != "UK Biobank")) 

# For pubmed id: 36716318
# FinnGen is a replication cohort only
rhd_cohort_norm <-
  rhd_cohort_norm |>
  filter(!(pubmed_id == "36716318" & cohort_group == "FinnGen"))

# for pubmed id: 23388002
# discovery cohort is three CHARGE cohorts
# AGES, Framingham, and MESA
# drop all other cohorts 

rhd_cohort_norm <-
  rhd_cohort_norm |>
      filter(
        !(pubmed_id == "23388002" & 
              !(cohort_group %in% c("Age Gene/Environment Susceptibility Reykjavik Study (AGES)", 
                                                           "Framingham Heart Study", 
                                                           "Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA)")
      )))

# for PUBMED ID, GCST9028115 is the only RHD relevant study
# and only UK Biobank Data was used for discovery in this Study
# drop all other cohorts
gwas_study_info |>
  filter(PUBMED_ID == "36716318")

rhd_cohort_norm <-
  rhd_cohort_norm |>
      filter(
        !(pubmed_id == "36716318" & 
              !(cohort_group %in% c("UK Biobank")
      )))

# for 32488134, UK Biobank is replication only
# Type 1 Diabetes Genetics Consortium is HLA imputation / reference panel 
rhd_cohort_norm <-
  rhd_cohort_norm |>
      filter(!(pubmed_id == "32488134" & cohort_group == "UK Biobank")) |> 
      filter(!(pubmed_id == "32488134" & cohort_group == "Type 1 Diabetes Genetics Consortium (T1DGC)"))


# 34594039, only  Biobank Japan (BBJ), FinnGen, UK Biobank are discovery cohorts
# drop all other cohorts
rhd_cohort_norm <-
    rhd_cohort_norm |>
      filter(
        !(pubmed_id == "34594039" & 
              !(cohort_group %in% c("Biobank Japan (BBJ)",
                                    "FinnGen",
                                    "UK Biobank")
      )))
  
rhd_cohort_norm  <-
  rhd_cohort_norm  |>
  distinct(pubmed_id, cohort_group)

# manually add any missing cohorts
add_manual_cohort_annot <-
  data.frame(pubmed_id = c(34106200, 
                           40465716, 
                           40770095, 
                           32066683, 
                           28492228, 
                           32488134),
             cohort_group = c("Genetics of Rheumatic Heart Disease (RHDGen)",
                              "HiGenome",
                              "UK Biobank",
                              "Unspecified Australian (Described in 21524186, 23010488, 20361910)",
                              "Pacific Islands Rheumatic Heart Disease Genetics Network",
                              "Pacific Islands Rheumatic Heart Disease Genetics Network; Unspecified Samples from Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGIMS) (Described in 23749169, 24797343, 25273327)"
             )
  )

rhd_cohort_norm <-
  rows_append(rhd_cohort_norm,
              add_manual_cohort_annot) |>
  tidyr::separate_longer_delim(cohort_group, ";") |>
  distinct()


# for 32488134 Fijian Indian Samples come from 28492228 (Pacific Islands Rheumatic Heart Disease Genetics Network)
# so although cohort not specified, add cohort here to ensure overlap is accounted for 
# gwas_ancest_info |> filter(PUBMED_ID == "28492228")  - 2017
# 168 Fijian Indian cases, 151 Fijian Indian controls
# the South Asian                   319   

# gwas_ancest_info_orig |> filter(PUBMED_ID == "32488134") - 2020
# 162 Fijian Indian cases, 147 Fijian Indian controls

# number of cohorts per pubmed id
rhd_cohort_norm  |>
  group_by(pubmed_id) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  filter(n > 1) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  head()

# number of pubmeds with only one cohort
rhd_cohort_norm  |>
  group_by(pubmed_id) |>
  summarise(n = n())  |>
  filter(n == 1) |>
  nrow()

rhd_cohort_pmids <-
rhd_cohort_norm |>
  pull(pubmed_id) |>
  unique()

# check that have cohort info for all relevant pmids:

stopifnot(all(rhd_cohort_pmids %in% rhd_pmids))
stopifnot(all(rhd_pmids %in% rhd_cohort_pmids))

# use semicolon instead of comma, to prevent later unwanted splitting
rhd_cohort_norm  <-
rhd_cohort_norm  |>
  group_by(pubmed_id) |>
  summarise(cohort = stringr::str_flatten(sort(cohort_group), 
                                          collapse = "; "),
            
            ) |>
  mutate(cohort = stringr::str_squish(cohort))

```


### Match cohorts to sample sizes 

```{r}

rhd_cohort_correction <-
left_join(
  rhd_cohort_norm |> rename(PUBMED_ID = pubmed_id),
  rhd_control_in_paper |> 
    select(-STUDY_ACCESSION, -ancest_cumsum),
  by = "PUBMED_ID"
) |>
  tidyr::separate_longer_delim(cohort, "; ") |>
  mutate(cohort = stringr::str_squish(cohort))


# drop mismatching cohorts to ancestry groups 

# all FinnGen Samples are European ancestry
rhd_cohort_correction <-
  rhd_cohort_correction |>
  filter(!c(ancestry_group != "European" & cohort == "FinnGen")) 

# no "Pacific Islands Rheumatic Heart Disease Genetics Network",
# Unspecified Samples from Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGIMS) (Described in 23749169, 24797343, 25273327) are European
rhd_cohort_correction <-
  rhd_cohort_correction |>
  filter(!c(ancestry_group == "European" & grepl("SGPGIMS|Pacific Islands", cohort)))

rhd_cohort_correction <-
  rhd_cohort_correction |>
  # 32488134 only uses European samples of 23&Me and UK Biobank 
  filter(!c(ancestry_group != "European" & cohort == "UK Biobank" & PUBMED_ID == "32488134")) |>
  filter(!c(ancestry_group != "European" & cohort == "23&Me" & PUBMED_ID == "32488134")) 

# 34594039o only uses European ancestry samples of UK Biobank
# and no samples in Biobank Japan (BBJ) are European ancestry
rhd_cohort_correction <-
  rhd_cohort_correction |>
   filter(!c(ancestry_group != "European" & cohort == "UK Biobank" & PUBMED_ID == "34594039")) |>
  filter(!c(ancestry_group == "European" & cohort %in% c("Biobank Japan (BBJ)", 
                                                         "Tohoku Medical Megabank") & PUBMED_ID == "34594039")
         ) 


# separate out Pacific Islands Rheumatic Heart Disease Genetics Network Samples 
# and other samples for PUBMED_ID: 32488134
rhd_cohort_correction <- 
  rhd_cohort_correction |>
  mutate(NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS = 
    case_when(
    PUBMED_ID == 32488134 & 
      ancestry_group != "European" &
      cohort == "Pacific Islands Rheumatic Heart Disease Genetics Network" ~ 309,
    PUBMED_ID == 32488134 & 
      ancestry_group != "European" &
      cohort != "Pacific Islands Rheumatic Heart Disease Genetics Network" ~ NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS - 309,
    TRUE ~ NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS )
  )

rhd_cohort_correction <- 
rhd_cohort_correction |>
  group_by(PUBMED_ID, ancestry_group, NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS, DATE) |>
  summarise(cohort = stringr::str_flatten(sort(cohort), 
                                          collapse = "; "),
            .groups = 'drop') |> 
  # if only single cohort per PUBMED and ancestry_group then all samples come from this cohort
  mutate(N_cohort = 
           ifelse(!grepl(";", cohort),
                           NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS,
                           NA)) 

# multi-study cohorts:
multi_study_cohorts <-
    rhd_cohort_norm  |>
    tidyr::separate_longer_delim(cohort, "; ") |>
    mutate(cohort = stringr::str_squish(cohort)) |>
    distinct(pubmed_id, cohort) |>
    group_by(cohort) |>
    summarise(n = n())  |>
    filter(n > 1) |>
    pull(cohort)


rhd_cohort_correction |> filter(is.na(N_cohort))

uses_shared <- sapply(strsplit(rhd_cohort_correction$cohort, "; "),
                      \(x) any(x %in% multi_study_cohorts))

# if N cannot be assigned to any cohort, but none of the cohorts are used as discovery in other papers
# no need to separate N_cohort out by cohort, so just assign N_cohort to NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS
rhd_cohort_correction <-
rhd_cohort_correction |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(N_cohort = 
           ifelse(!uses_shared & is.na(N_cohort),
                  NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS,
                  N_cohort
                  )
         )

# what N left to assign: 
rhd_cohort_correction |> filter(is.na(N_cohort))

# just need to disambiguate FinnGen from UK Biobank for 34594039
# ? can't see in paper how to disambiguate .. 
# so estimate from relative proportions of FinnGen to UK Biobank overall taken from Extended Data Fig. 1
# (assuming approximately same level of missing phenotypes per biobank)

ukbb_34594039_ratio = 358000 / (136000 + 358000)

# double check that spliting on FinnGen; is not going to create problems
stopifnot(
nrow(
rhd_cohort_correction |> 
  filter(grepl("FinnGen; ", cohort)) 
) == 1
)

stopifnot(
nrow(
rhd_cohort_correction |> 
  filter(grepl("FinnGen; ", cohort))  |>
  filter(PUBMED_ID == "34594039")
) == 1
)

rhd_cohort_correction <-
rhd_cohort_correction |>
  ungroup() |>
  tidyr::separate_longer_delim(cohort, 
                               delim = 
                                 stringr::regex("FinnGen; ")
) |>
  mutate(cohort = ifelse(
    cohort == "" & PUBMED_ID == 34594039,
    "FinnGen",
    cohort
  )) |>
  mutate(N_cohort = 
           case_when(PUBMED_ID == 34594039 & cohort == "UK Biobank" & is.na(N_cohort) ~ 
                      round(ukbb_34594039_ratio  * NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS, digits = 0),
                     PUBMED_ID == 34594039 & cohort == "FinnGen" & is.na(N_cohort) ~ 
                      round((1 - ukbb_34594039_ratio) * NUMBER_OF_INDIVIDUALS, digits = 0), 
                     TRUE ~ N_cohort
                     )
         )


# check no shared cohort is within a multi-cohort row
uses_shared <- sapply(strsplit(rhd_cohort_correction$cohort, "; "),
                      \(x) any(x %in% multi_study_cohorts))

stopifnot(
nrow(
rhd_cohort_correction  |>
  filter(grepl(";", cohort) & uses_shared) 
) == 0
)
  
stopifnot(
nrow(
```

### Plot cumulative samples 

```{r}

rhd_cohort_correction_final <-
  rhd_cohort_correction |>
  arrange(ancestry_group, cohort, DATE) |>
  group_by(ancestry_group, cohort) |>
  mutate(
    previous_max = lag(cummax(N_cohort), default = 0),
    N_new        = pmax(N_cohort - previous_max, 0),
    N_cumsum     = cumsum(N_new)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(ancestry_group, DATE) |>          # <- add this
  group_by(ancestry_group) |>
  mutate(ancest_cumsum = cumsum(as.numeric(N_new))) |>
  ungroup()

#         N_cumsum = cumsum(N_new)
#     ) |>
#   ungroup() |>

#   arrange(ancestry_group, cohort, DATE) |>
#   mutate(ancest_cumsum = cumsum(as.numeric(N_new))) 

rhd_cohort_correction_final_plot_df <-
rhd_cohort_correction_final  |>
  add_final_totals() |>
  ungroup()

rhd_cohort_correction_smooth_final_plot_df <- 
  rhd_cohort_correction_final_plot_df |>
  arrange(ancestry_group, cohort, DATE) |> 
  group_by(ancestry_group) |>
  mutate(month = floor_date(DATE, "month")) |>
  arrange(month) |>
  group_by(ancestry_group, month) |>
  summarise(ancest_cumsum = max(ancest_cumsum), 
            .groups = "drop") |>
  complete(ancestry_group,
           month = seq(min(month), max(month), 
                       by = "month")) |>   # same grid for all groups
  group_by(ancestry_group) |>
  arrange(month, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  fill(ancest_cumsum, .direction = "down") |>                       # carry totals forward
  replace_na(list(ancest_cumsum = 0)) |>                            # 0 before first study
  mutate(smooth = slide_dbl(ancest_cumsum, mean,
                            .before = window_months, 
                            .after = 0)) |>  # trailing window
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# check all pubmeds included in both datasets
uncorrected_df_pmids <- rhd_no_correction  |> 
                        filter(!is.na(PUBMED_ID)) |>
                        pull(PUBMED_ID) |> 
                        unique() 

corrected_df_pmids <- rhd_cohort_correction_final_plot_df  |> 
                      filter(!is.na(PUBMED_ID)) |>
                      pull(PUBMED_ID) |> 
                      unique()

all(
uncorrected_df_pmids %in% corrected_df_pmids
)

all(
corrected_df_pmids %in% uncorrected_df_pmids
)

after_correction_ps <-
rhd_cohort_correction_final_plot_df |> 
  group_by(ancestry_group) |> 
  slice_max(ancest_cumsum) |>
  distinct(ancest_cumsum, ancestry_group) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(percentage = ancest_cumsum / sum(ancest_cumsum)) 

before_correction_ps <-
  rhd_no_correction |>
  group_by(ancestry_group) |> 
  slice_max(ancest_cumsum) |>
  distinct(ancest_cumsum, ancestry_group) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(percentage = ancest_cumsum / sum(ancest_cumsum)) 

total_n_analysed <-
before_correction_ps |>
pull(ancest_cumsum) |>
sum()

  
rbinom(
       n = 10,
       size =  total_n_analysed,
       prob = before_correction_ps |>
            filter(ancestry_group == "European") |>
            pull(percentage)
         )

# assuming random sampling from collected samples 

# probability of observing >= number of European samples
pbinom(
  q = before_correction_ps |>
      filter(ancestry_group == "European") |>
      pull(ancest_cumsum),
  size =  total_n_analysed, #total number of analysed samples
  prob =  after_correction_ps |>
          filter(ancestry_group == "European") |>
           pull(percentage),
  lower.tail = FALSE
         )

# 95% expected range of percentage 0.65
qbinom(
  p = c(0.025, 0.975),
       size =  total_n_analysed,
       prob = after_correction_ps |>
               filter(ancestry_group == "European") |>
               pull(percentage),
  lower.tail = TRUE
         ) / total_n_analysed


qbinom(
  p = c(0.025, 0.975),
       size =  total_n_analysed,
       prob = after_correction_ps |>
            filter(ancestry_group == "Asian") |>
            pull(percentage),
  lower.tail = TRUE
         ) / total_n_analysed
```

```{r rhd_plot_line_plot_all_corrections_powerpoint_pres}
  geom_line(linewidth = 2,
            linetype = 2,
            alpha = 0.75,
            show.legend = FALSE) + 
  # geom_point(size = 10) + 
    scale_colour_manual(values = ancestry_colors, 
                      name = "Ancestry group",
                      labels = \(x) gsub("/", "/\n", x)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ancestry_colors,   
                    name = "Ancestry group",
                    labels = \(x) gsub("/", "/\n", x)) +
  scale_starshape_manual(values = c(15, 
                                    13,
                                    11,
                                    23,
                                    28,
                                    1,
                                    29
                                    ),
                         name = "Ancestry group",
                         labels = \(x) gsub("/", "/\n", x)) +
  geom_star(aes(starshape = ancestry_group), 
            size = 5) +  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 100),
                     limits = c(0, 1)
                     #expand = c(0, 0)
                     ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(y = "Proportion in GWAS catalog",
       title = "A. Rheumatic Heart Disease Papers")+ 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = scales::label_wrap(22)) +
        theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next"),
    #axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = unit(0.2, "in")),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 20,
                                colour = "black"),  
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 20,
                                colour = "black"), 
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 27,
                              # hjust = -0.025,
                              margin = margin(b = 0.4,
                                              unit = "in")
                              ),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20,
                                colour = "black",
                                margin = margin(r = 0.2,
                                                unit = "in")
                                ),
    # legend.title = element_text(size = 32), 
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 18,
                                colour = "black"),
    legend.justification = "bottom",
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.key.spacing.y = unit(2, "pt"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, 
                                margin = margin(b = 0.1,
                                               unit = "in"
                                               ),
                               colour = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(l = 0,
                               unit = "in"
                                 ),
    plot.margin = margin(t =  0.1,
                         r =  0,
                         l =  0.1,
                         b = 0.2,
                         unit = "in"
        ),
    panel.border = element_blank(), 
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey60"),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(colour = "grey60")
```

```{r rhd_plot_line_plot_all_corrections_stackedbarplot}
mid_correction  <-

  distinct(ancest_cumsum, ancestry_group) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(percentage = ancest_cumsum / sum(ancest_cumsum)) 

different_ancestry_comp <-

  mutate(type = "After_correction"),

)

  mutate(type = "Mid_correction")
)
```
